A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MoDES research and contain complete main texts and Appendices A-G. Text and visual inspection support comparison of their equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark comparisons, inference and search timing measurements, ablations, and qualitative examples in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark tables and appendix comparisons, ablations, and visual examples.

M1.justification: GMLG, dual-modality thresholding, calibration, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Appendix B adds CUDA implementation details without establishing a change to the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight image and five video benchmarks, GQA calibration data, and alternative calibration datasets in Table 5. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain fixed top-k routing, NAEE, MC-MoE, and DiEP; Table 2 retains the MC-MoE quantization comparison. The revised baseline tuning procedure changes settings, not comparator membership or the stated skipping rules.

E3.justification: Appendix B replaces sequential layer-wise baseline hyperparameter tuning with genetic search under a given skipping ratio, removing the cumulative layer-wise constraint description. Other evaluation settings remain unchanged. This is a reported protocol revision; the PDFs do not establish whether experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The component and calibration-data ablations, sample-count and grid-size studies, layer/modality analyses, and qualitative examples are retained. No new ablation, robustness test, or case-study evidence is introduced.

E5.justification: Run counts, seeds, uncertainty-estimation procedures, and significance testing receive no new reporting. The numerical tables and existing shaded plots retain the same statistical presentation.

E6.justification: Section 6.5 corrects the reported trend from skipping more experts in shallow layers to skipping more in deeper layers, matching the unchanged Figure 8. Numerical results in Tables 1-5 and I-IV, plotted measurements, and qualitative examples remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, monotonicity assumption, frontier-search formulation, and Appendix A lemmas, propositions, and proofs are unchanged, including the O(ND) complexity argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, contribution, accuracy-retention, and efficiency claims. The added code-availability sentence does not alter the scientific claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B adds an explanation of low inference overhead: thresholding occurs inside the router kernel, skipped routes are filtered before execution, and only a few element-wise operations are added. This supplies a new execution-level explanation for the existing speedup results; broader applicability and limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract newly supplies a code repository link. Appendix B documents branch-free threshold comparisons, sentinel expert IDs, and dispatch filtering, alongside the revised baseline-search description. These are documentation and access-information changes; actual repository availability is not verified by the PDFs.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to LLMC, LLMC+, Routing Experts, and work on dynamic visual-token exit, expanding the bibliography from 64 to 68 works. The training-aware/training-free framing and MoDES positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes are localized: expanded Appendix B prose, the code-availability sentence, an acknowledgment section, and wording corrections. The main narrative and appendix section order are preserved.

P2.justification: Existing displays are repositioned through text reflow, including Table 5 and Figure 7 moving between columns and Table III moving relative to its discussion. Spacing changes and page-number footers disappear, but no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves implementation transparency through the code link and router-kernel details, and corrects Section 6.5's contradiction with Figure 8. These are useful, limited gains. The revised genetic-search baseline tuning remains underspecified and is not accompanied by changed scores or a rerun explanation, so stronger empirical validation cannot be inferred.
